purpose: Test a small shared typed encoder against independent engine transitions; alignment is auxiliary
admission_before_launch: Pin eight complete runtime-admitted card definitions and reviewed source/program/stage bindings
Pin public context bank, source hashes, supported constructs and expected boundary cases before collection
Keep reprints/canonical identity aliases together; six training identities and two held-out identities
Include familiar mechanics under distinct IDs and confusable printed properties with different mechanics
Pin model shapes, initialization, target normalization and actual dataset/split manifests
Stop if coverage cannot meet these gates; do not strip unsupported card sides or invent behavioral labels

labels: settled terminal status and final offered-action mask
collection.private_information: No hidden order, opponent hands or future outcomes in current inputs

fit.selection: Fixed final step; no hyperparameter or checkpoint search
fit.objective: Independent legality/cost/state-delta/follow-up targets, plus a smaller role-masked program/action alignment term
fit.controls: Identical architecture shapes, parameter counts, contexts, labels, initialization, batches and update ceilings

resource_limits.retry_policy: Preserve attempts; subtract spent wall time, applies, updates and validation calls rather than reset allocation

evaluation.primary: Held-out identity transition and affordance prediction
evaluation.distance_labels: Predeclared mask Hamming and normalized observed-delta distances from shared Kessel contexts, never embedding-feature overlap
evaluation.distance_diagnostics: Cosine/Euclidean rank correlation and neighbor retrieval only when independent labels vary; report two-query support and dependence, without population claims
evaluation.global_vs_conditional: Fixed-context-mixture card distance versus explicit card/context/role query distance
evaluation.strength: No games, win-rate, metagame or policy-strength claim

budget.note: Local CPU first. This proposal does not launch a job or create a new spending allowance.

diagnostic_priority.recorded_case: Readying an enemy Cinta is followed by its immediate lethal attack. No saving alternative is proven.
diagnostic_priority.next_fixture: An independently admitted readiness/ownership/terminal microfixture, rather than replay counterfactuals through an unsupported bridge.
diagnostic_priority.current_gap: The present typed adapter does not admit Ready effects or full-game reconstruction; extend and verify that subset separately before using the diagnostic as a training fixture.

supersession_reason: Eric explicitly requested a useful experiment using existing verified runtime coverage. The old eight-card held-out-ID gate is no longer a launch requirement. The immediate two-card pilot holds out grouped public context families and makes no unseen-card claim.
